readiness_decision.rationale: TASK-1040 runtime extraction plan markdown (17 sections) and JSON (21 top-level fields, 24 fail-closed rows, 19 golden CLI requirements, 15 future-task acceptance criteria FTC-1..FTC-15, 48 non_authorization keys all false) are complete and verified (TASK-1040 inspection JSON overall_status=pass with 25/25 checks pass). TASK-1039 prototype remains design-only. TASK-1038 v3.5.x closure index protected_surfaces remain intact. TASK-1037 24 golden CLI cases are frozen and provide the repair schema template (split actual_status / observed_cli_status). TASK-1035 Evidence Ref runtime extraction has already validated the explicit-CLI activation pattern (--evidence-ref-policy) which the future --waiver-policy implementation will mirror. All FTC-1..FTC-15 future-task acceptance criteria are individually scorable and the seven gates (golden CLI, Evidence Ref, runner mirror, fail-closed, rollback, human authorization, Codex verification) are surfaced with explicit acceptance criteria. The decision indicates that the planning context is sufficient to permit a separately authorized future implementation lifecycle; it does NOT authorize implementation by itself.

readiness_criteria.description: Future implementation lifecycle must obtain explicit human authorization (arcobaleno) before any file modification; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-1.

Implementation scope allowlist must be defined and enforced; staging set limited to TASK-1042 lifecycle artifacts, runtime registry JSON, run_quality_gates.py runner mirror pair, and TASK-1042 evidence; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-2.
Root runner and template mirror sha256 prefix must remain consistent; remaining four production validator/test files sha256 prefix unchanged; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-3 / PR-1..PR-8.
Without --waiver-policy flag, quality gate run must pass TASK-1029 fixtures byte-identically; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-4 / BC-1.
FC-01..FC-24 corresponding controlled fixtures and negative-case tests must land in future implementation; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-5 / fail_closed_matrix.
GCLI-WAIVER-001..019 must all lock in future implementation result JSON; inherits TASK-1037 repair schema; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-6 / golden_cli_coverage_requirements.
FC-16 corresponding controlled negative case must pass; waiver evidence_ref must route through evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json (or successor); mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-7 / evidence_ref_integration.

Five production validator/test files (guard_status_validator.py, guard_contract_validator.py, workflow_constants.py, run_red_team_suite.py, test_guard_units.py) sha256 prefix must remain unchanged; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-8.
PCACC active surface must remain four (PCACC-001..PCACC-004); PCACC-005 must not be introduced; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-9 / BC-8.
AC-to-verify coverage must remain excluded; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-10 / BC-9.
Codex (agent_roles.negative_tester) must perform read-only PASS/FAIL verification on the future implementation commit and the result must be PASS; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-11.

Rollback strategy (RB-1..RB-9) must be inheritable into the future implementation lifecycle; rollback restores runner/template pair, preserves prototype/design and TASK-1040 plan artifacts as historical records, and does not lift any non_authorization boundary; mirrors TASK-1040 plan §13.
Future implementation lifecycle must not retroactively modify TASK-1023..TASK-1041 lifecycle artifacts; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-12.
Future implementation lifecycle must not lift TASK-1040 plan JSON non_authorization boundary (except runtime consumption surface explicitly authorized by FTC-1); mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-13.

Runtime registry must live at artifacts/governance/waiver-policy-registry.v<version>.json (active runtime path); separate from prototype path (artifacts/governance/prototypes/...); prototype must not be promoted to runtime registry; mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-14.
Runtime registry schema_version must be waiver-policy-registry/v1 (distinct from prototype's waiver-policy-registry-prototype/v1); mirrors TASK-1040 plan FTC-15 / runtime_loading_model LM-2.

limitations: TASK-1041 is decision-only; this readiness decision does not authorize any runtime extraction implementation, runtime consumption, or runner attachment.

The decision mirrors the contract recorded in artifacts/governance/waiver-policy-runtime-extraction-plan.v3.5.8.md/.json (HEAD bbdd7ad); later edits to the plan invalidate this readiness decision until re-validated under a separate decision artifact.

readiness_criteria FTC mappings (FTC-1..FTC-15) preserve TASK-1040 plan JSON future_task_acceptance_criteria one-to-one; future runtime adoption must keep these byte-identical until a successor readiness decision lands.
non_authorization is explicit and load-bearing; any reading of this readiness decision as implicit authorization is incorrect.
future_implementation_allowlist enumerates the path patterns a future task may modify; TASK-1041 itself must not modify any of them, and authorized_now is false for every entry.

Even where readiness_decision.decision is ready_for_separate_human_authorization, this readiness decision does not authorize implementation; a future implementation lifecycle must obtain explicit human authorization (arcobaleno) and satisfy FTC-1..FTC-15 plus the seven gates recorded here.
Inspection evidence is a static self-attestation written at TASK-1041 commit time; Codex performs post-commit PASS/FAIL re-verification against the live working tree per agent_roles.negative_tester.

GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-005 / GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-006 cases recorded in golden-cli-coverage-matrix.v3.5.4.json remain implementation_authorized=false at TASK-1037 closure; this readiness decision does not lift that boundary.

QB-DRIFT-0001 (template_mirror_drift on test_guard_units.py) remains baseline_existing without remediation or waiver; this readiness decision does NOT issue a waiver for QB-DRIFT-0001 and does NOT lift the TASK-1038 closure-index non-authorization on QB-DRIFT-0001 remediation.

Unresolved questions UD-1 (schema_version pinning), UD-2 (file location flat vs nested), UD-3 (multi-source merge) recorded in TASK-1040 plan §16 remain unresolved; they are not readiness blockers and are deferred to future TASK-1042 plan.

Schema validation of this readiness matrix is performed only by the inspection evidence JSON at artifacts/verify/TASK-1041/waiver-runtime-readiness-inspection.json; no production runner or validator consumes this readiness matrix.
